meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 该技能启动5个互相敌对的AI成员交叉批评你的规划想法，只保留经受住攻击的见解，再强制交给规划代理形成正式计划。
howto.when: 当你说出 hyperplan、hpp 等触发词，或需要严格规划、暴露弱假设与盲点时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个项目的上线步骤。
say.note: 启动对抗式辩论，输出正式执行计划。

say.text: hyperplan：我要做一个新功能，制定详细开发计划。
say.note: 触发交叉批评，暴露弱假设和盲点。

say.text: 请用敌对规划模式检查我的方案有哪些漏洞。
say.note: 展开交叉批评，只保留站得住脚的结论。

howto.what_en: It starts 5 hostile AI members cross-critiquing your plan, keeps only the surviving insights, then mandates the plan agent to write a formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say trigger words like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', etc., or ask for strict planning, exposing weak assumptions and blind spots.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan the launch steps of this project.
say_en.note: Starts adversarial debate and outputs a formal plan.

say_en.text: hyperplan: I need a detailed development plan for a new feature.
say_en.note: Triggers cross-critique and exposes weak assumptions.

say_en.text: Please use hostile planning mode to check my proposal for flaws.
say_en.note: Runs cross-critique and keeps only defensible points.
